svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1524 commits across five public projects, 69 active days, peak 169 commits per day. 2026-09-05 through 2026-11-27 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-27T23:36:19.009Z.
